Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:47615
Court No. - 14

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 14393 of 2022
Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Maurya
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Saud Rais,Prabhat,Rajesh Kumar Verma,Ram Prakash Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
Counter affidavit filed by learned Aga for the State is taken on record.
Heard Shri Saud Rais, learned counsel for the accused/applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Santosh Kumar Maurya for grant of bail, in Case Crime No. 349 of 2022, under Sections 376, 342, 506 IPC, Police Station Malihabad,
District Lucknow, during trial.

Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the accused-applicant has falsely been implicated in the instant case and he has not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

sentences.text: 1 It is further submitted that in the FIR which has been lodged by the father of the prosecutrix, the allegations are pertaining to the molestation only and the FIR has been lodged on the basis of the information given by the prosecutrix to her parents, as is also evident from the statement of the mother of the prosecutrix recorded by the investigating officer.
Even in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded U/s 161 CrPC, there is no mention of any sexual assault and the allegations are limited only to molestation.

However in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded U/s 164 CrPC, for the very first time, the allegation of rape/sexual assault has been levelled against the applicant,
which in the facts and circumstances of the case could not be believed and it appears that under the influence of her parents, the prosecutrix has levelled allegations of rape against the applicant.

It is further submitted that the factum that there is no sexual assault/rape committed on the prosecutrix, is also evident from the fact that at first, the prosecutrix and her mother had refused to submit the prosecutrix for internal examination.
However, when she was medically examined, her hymen was found intact which is a prima facie proof that the prosecutrix has not been subjected to rape.

It is further submitted that the date of birth of the prosecutrix, as per the case of the prosecution, is 12.5.2002 and thus, at the date and time of the alleged incident, she was aged about 20 years.
It is further submitted that the applicant is in jail in this case since 23.8.2022 and he is not having any criminal antecedents.
Charge sheet in the matter has already been filed and there is no apprehension that the accused-applicant after release on bail, may flee from the process of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
Learned A.G.A., on the other hand submits that having manner on which the offence has been committed the applicant is not entitled for any relief.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that in the FIR and even in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded U/s 161 CrPC, there is no mention of rape.
However, in her statement recorded U/s 164 CrPC
, she, for the very first time, has stated the allegation of rape against the applicant.

The FIR, as highlighted by learned counsel for the applicant,
has been lodged on the information of the incident given by the prosecutrix to her parents.
The medical examination report of the prosecutrix would reveal that her hymen was found intact.
The age of the prosecutrix was about 20 years at the date and time of the alleged incident.
The applicant is jail in this case since 23.8.2022 without any criminal history.
His presence could be secured before the trial court by placing any adequate conditions.

Keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits and demerits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Santosh Kumar Maurya involved in the aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court Santosh Kumar Maurya vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
